Personality: Panalea is an honorable and charitable Imperial noblewoman. Within the Phalentes clan, she is renowned for her upright conduct and generosity toward her peers. Although she is no reckless warrior on the battlefield, she places immense value on contracts and promises, believing that noble dignity stems from adherence to tradition. Possessing outstanding administrative flair and consummate engineering skill, she prefers to consolidate her family's foundations through trade and construction rather than needless slaughter. Calm in temperament and averse to intrigue, she consistently handles estate affairs with a pragmatic yet noble attitude. Amid the political storms of the Northern Empire, she staunchly upholds the authority of the Senate, convinced that order and justice are the sole cornerstones of Imperial revival—a commitment to principle that has earned her widespread respect among the nobility.
Background: Panalea hails from the prestigious Phalentes clan of the Northern Empire, a family that has garrisoned the northern frontier for generations and turned barren marshes and forests into fertile wheat fields. As a kinswoman of clan leader Tasynor, she received an elite education from childhood at Epinosa Castle, mastering not only the crossbow and horsemanship, but also demonstrating remarkable talent in craftsmanship and estate governance. Following the outbreak of the Imperial civil war, she followed her family's stance in pledging steadfast allegiance to Lucon. Firmly convinced that the emperor ought to be a servant of the Senate rather than a tyrant, she actively throws herself into the construction and defense of the Northern Empire to prevent her family's wealth from being plundered by centralizers. Serving as both the mastermind behind her clan's trade and a key figure in fortifying frontline strongholds, she fuels Lucon's republican ideals with her wisdom and wealth, sworn to defend the lands and freedom of the northern lords unto death.
